projects.name: macroEngine-Datapack-v26.4
projects.reason: Datapacks are retired in favor of Fabric mods (see README 'Datapack maintenance status'); archived read-only for reference, no further fixes planned.
known_issues: Several macro sinks run $(cmd) with no permission gate (api/trigger/call2, systems/hook/run_cmd, api/wand/call_cmd, and others); admins are only notified or the call is only logged.
api/cmd/ban, kick, gamerule, effect_give_all pass raw macro arguments into commands.
Pairs with macroEngine-Resourcepack-v26.4 (required for i18n, sounds, trim assets), which is still under packs/.
